notes.title: New Year update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Just a little follow up from the last update.

[list]
[*] Heroes will now have trophies next to them after beating bosses.
[*] Orc and Undead perks now stack correctly (before this patch secondary bonuses were not applied correctly).
[*] Difficulty levels will now have perks and penalties applied correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content:
Hi guys. Just a minor patch rollout that mainly tries to address issues some players have with unlocking content.

How it worked previously: Pretty much everything was based on Steam achievements. If you did a campaign mission that unlocks a hero, you'd get an achievement, and that achievement was checked for when seeing if your content is unlocked.

This currently doesn't work for some users (not just pirates! :) ) so we're now adding a backup. We'll also be storing achievement data in your save file, which should be pretty much full proof (famous last words). 

Lastly we added order colours to the formation when you load it in!

notes.title: Tactics update!
notes.content:
Hi guys! We've been reading your reviews, discussions and e-mails since the game's release and took a lot of feedback on board. TACTICS update brings it all together with some new QoL features, as well as something that changes the game completely. Priority orders.

[h1]Tactics[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/29326c8c6aa88de7e88433c935bdfd375b3b7f5f.png[/img]

Before the battle begins, you're now able to select a tactic your units use. You can target the closest unit, Ranged Troops, Cavalry or Infantry. Your units will ignore other unit types as long as selected tactic is in effect (until the chosen enemy type is dead).

This means your cavalry can now actually flank and dash for ranged troops, rather than going for the closest enemy every time.

We've also updated how AI works - troops no longer select a target at the beginning and stick to them no matter what - instead they'll re-evaluate the target during the battle, always going for the closest enemy (if that's the chosen tactic).

For now, the AI does not use any other strategy than closest enemy - we're still thinking whether to change that and would love your input on this.

[h1]Saved Formations[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/96d839f6ae7a2f643ac1ff436e78957fc19c7897.png[/img]

In Adventure mode you'll find a new button - it will load the troop placement from the previous battle. We found it to be quite useful, especially with specific builds.

[h1]Range information[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/c8d74c5cd22cb63265ddc936044b244fc80c0228.png[/img]

Another QoL that you've requested is ranged information. You're now able to view the range of attack of individual units - both yours and the enemy. 

Lastly... we know that some players have had issues with Steam Achievements. A lot of the progress is saved through them (for example unlocking other races by defeating the enemy bosses). We know that the game always works on the second run, but for some it won't do on the first run. Just in case we did add something that should track most important achievements regardless of Steam status, and award them on next run.

Please let us know what you think of these changes. We drive the development of the game with your feedback, so it's super important for us. Also please considering reviewing the game if you haven't done so already! It REALLY helps us! We hope to get back to Very Positive, rather than Mixed :)

notes.title: Expanding the playable Factions!
notes.content:
Hi guys. We've been very quiet about the game over the several months simply because we were busy working on it! We figured that it's best to wait until things are ready, rather than promise stuff that wouldn't have necessarily made it into the game for one reason or another.

Roguelike Mode has been renamed to "Adventure" and is now the main mode in the game. There's no two ways about it: it is the most fun and challenging out of the three. With that being said, we now also have new factions you can play as in Adventure mode!

That's right, all factions you meet on the battlefield are available to you as well. Not right off the bat though! You need to first defeat their respective heroes (bosses) to unlock the factions themselves. Every faction has also received new augments and modifiers to make them feel a bit more unique. This means you're unlikely to find the same rewards after battle, or the shop when you play as different factions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/a2fdc89d89262a2eb2ccfc5091ac39d4f3e33246.jpg[/img]

To make things a bit less random and annoying, the pool of bosses you can fight always takes into consideration who you've already defeated, and will reset to fully random once you've defeated all of them.

Except for the Kingdom, each faction has a [b]Unique Mechanic[/b]. Let's go through them:

[h2]The Undead[/h2]
Undead collect souls as they slay their enemies. You'll be able to claim a reward at various thresholds (not yet visible in the screenshot, still WIP) in form of a new augment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/2f70962d91d221811d5bf962532470de999023c4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Barbarians[/h2]
Barbarians reward a unique playstyle. Where it's mostly beneficial to focus on a few strengths, barbarians reward a varied army composition. For every 10 different unit types you place, you gain [b]Barbarian Unity[/b]. Each level gives you +10% damage, which is a hefty bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/2b43aadbce552ee33862e8943cdf2e4d86d37fb9.jpg[/img]

Additionally you can [b]PLUNDER stores[/b]! Instead of purchasing things for money (which no barbarian likes to spend!) you can simply rob the store and receive a random reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/5e29ebe751b1c9d3301606b5dd96a88856d2f1cb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Greenskins[/h2]
Everybody knows that Orcs like to bonk people on the head with whatever they have at hand, and if there's nothing at hand, they'll grab another person, and bonk others with them.

Greenskins have a Waagh meter, which represents their readiness for battle. It increases by a little every time you choose to fight something, and decreases HEAVILY if you choose to step onto a shop, or an event (providing it's not an ambush, in which case the Orcs will love it).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/7aee03442e082fb06e1a7fb32a3a482ef7db731e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/d69e6499b6723893926f808cf60e3b2eb5ac7866.jpg[/img]

If your Waagh is too low, orcs will think you're a boring leader, and will be a lot less eager to fight (hence get penalties to combat instead of bonuses). For this reason, it's a faction which values careful planning of your path (and unfortunately sometimes RNG can screw you, so be ready for that too!).

That's all we have for you for today, and I hope you're looking forward to the game. Please remember to wishlist if you haven't yet, and send it to your friends!
